{{- /* Tab – child of tabs shortcode Usage: inside {{< tabs >}}...{{< /tabs >}} {{< tab name="Tab 1" >}}Content{{< /tab >}} Content is markdown-rendered here and stored as safe HTML. */ -}} {{- $name := .Get "name" | default (printf "Tab %d" .Ordinal) -}} {{- $content := .InnerDeindent | .Page.RenderString -}} {{- $tabs := .Parent.Store.Get "tabs" | default slice -}} {{- .Parent.Store.Set "tabs" ($tabs | append (dict "name" $name "content" $content)) -}}
